newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah easier on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah easier on ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was easier against the dollar in late trading on Tuesday on sustained ample liquidity, dealers said.
They said the market remained generally slow while the central bank kept the system flush ahead of year-end tax payments.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,405.50/06.00 at 1000 GMT compared with an opening of 2,404.00/05.00.
The central bank's sustained large injection was partly aimed at keeping interest rates low for tax payments, dealers said.
They said the rupiah spot rate was likely to remain at around 2405.00/06.00 on Wednesday.
